svg.aria-label: F43.1 durable sessions: the interface design
svg.title: F43.1 durable sessions: the interface design

g.text: F43.1 durable sessions: the interface design

text.tspan: AgentSessions keeps its sessions in memory as today and writes each one through ISessionStore, which a setting fills with the in-memory or the
MongoDB store. A session is saved as how it opened and then its turns; resumed, it is opened again from that request with its history
restored. The number in brackets is the step that builds it.
